title: Factorization of the pre-quotient wedge map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ a short exact sequence of module sheaves. Let $r_1,r_2,r_3\in\mathbb N$, $r_2=r_1+r_3$, with $A$ finite locally free of rank $r_1$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Write $T=(\bigwedge^{r_1}A)\otimes(\bigwedge^{r_3}B)$ and $Q=(\bigwedge^{r_1}A)\otimes(\bigwedge^{r_3}C)$ using [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Suppose morphisms $q:T\to Q$ and $\psi:T\to\bigwedge^{r_2}B$ are given. For every open $U$ and tuples $a\in A(U)^{r_1}$, $c\in B(U)^{r_3}$ suppose $q_U((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge c_j))=(\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge g_U(c_j))$ and $\psi_U((\bigwedge a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge c_j))=\bigwedge(f_U(a_1),\ldots,f_U(a_{r_1}),c_1,\ldots,c_{r_3})$. Then there is $\varphi:Q\to\bigwedge^{r_2}B$ with $\varphi\circ q=\psi$.

proof.text: The formula on tensors of pure wedges identifies q with the tensor exterior map: apply the explicit exterior map construction to g, tensor it with the identity, and compare on the locally generating wedge tensors. Stalkwise g is surjective by exactness, so finite tuples lift. Pure wedges span, giving surjectivity of its exterior map and of its tensor with the first factor. Hence q is an epimorphism of module sheaves.

For a quotient B/K, the exterior quotient relations are generated by pure wedges with one factor in K: its alternating maps are exactly alternating maps on B that vanish when an argument belongs to K, by applying multilinearity to two representatives differing by an element of K. Applying the tensor universal property gives the same presentation after tensoring with the first exterior factor. This identifies the kernel generators locally. Exactness identifies K with the image of f.

Trivialize A on a cover. The value of psi on a kernel generator has r1+1 factors from A. Expand in a basis of size r1. Every resulting term repeats one basis factor and is zero by alternation, as in the exterior-power basis theorem. Thus psi kills the kernel of q locally, hence as a sheaf morphism. Rank zero has zero kernel A, and quotient exterior degree zero has no kernel generators.

In the abelian category of module sheaves an epimorphism is the cokernel of its kernel. The cokernel universal property therefore produces phi satisfying q followed by phi equals psi. This step asserts no value formula for phi; that formula is obtained by evaluating the factorization in the parent proof.

theorem determinant_wedge_quotient_factor {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ)
    (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃) [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁]
    (q : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃)
    (ψ : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      q.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₃ U c)) =
        tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁)
          (N := exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃) (U := U)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i))))
    (hψ : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
      ψ.val.app (op U)
        (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
          (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₃ U c)) =
        exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))) :
    ∃ φ : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂,
      q ≫ φ = ψ
